record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, <FI>even<Fi> to Jeduthun<WH03038>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, I will take heed<WH08104><WTH8799> to my ways<WH01870>, that I sin<WH02398><WTH8800> not with my tongue<WH03956>: I will keep<WH08104><WTH8799> my mouth<WH06310> with a bridle<WH04269>, while the wicked<WH07563> is before me. <RF>my mouth...: Heb. a bridle, or, muzzle for my mouth<Rf>

I was dumb<WH0481><WTH8738> with silence<WH01747>, I held my peace<WH02814><WTH8689>, <FI>even<Fi> from good<WH02896>; and my sorrow<WH03511> was stirred<WH05916><WTH8738>. <RF>stirred: Heb. troubled<Rf>

My heart<WH03820> was hot<WH02552><WTH8804> within<WH07130> me, while I was musing<WH01901> the fire<WH0784> burned<WH01197><WTH8799>: <FI>then<Fi><WH0227> spake<WH01696><WTH8765> I with my tongue<WH03956>,

LORD<WH03068>, make me to know<WH03045><WTH8685> mine end<WH07093>, and the measure<WH04060> of my days<WH03117>, what it <FI>is; that<Fi> I may know<WH03045><WTH8799> how frail<WH02310> I <FI>am<Fi> . <RF>how...: or, what time I have here<Rf>

Behold, thou hast made<WH05414><WTH8804> my days<WH03117> <FI>as<Fi> an handbreadth<WH02947>; and mine age<WH02465> <FI>is<Fi> as nothing before thee: verily every<WH03605> man<WH0120> at his best state<WH05324><WTH8737> <FI>is<Fi> altogether<WH03605> vanity<WH01892>. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>at...: Heb. settled<Rf>

Surely every man<WH0376> walketh<WH01980><WTH8691> in a vain shew<WH06754>: surely they are disquieted<WH01993><WTH8799> in vain<WH01892>: he heapeth up<WH06651><WTH8799> <FI>riches<Fi> , and knoweth<WH03045><WTH8799> not who shall gather<WH0622><WTH8802> them. <RF>a vain...: Heb. an image<Rf><CM>
And now, Lord<WH0136>, what wait<WH06960><WTH8765> I for? my hope<WH08431> <FI>is<Fi> in thee.
Deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me from all my transgressions<WH06588>: make<WH07760><WTH8799> me not the reproach<WH02781> of the foolish<WH05036>.
I was dumb<WH0481><WTH8738>, I opened<WH06605><WTH8799> not my mouth<WH06310>; because thou didst<WH06213><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> .
Remove<WH05493><WH00> thy stroke<WH05061> away<WH05493><WTH8685> from me: I am consumed<WH03615><WTH8804> by the blow<WH08409> of thine hand<WH03027>. <RF>blow: Heb. conflict<Rf>

When thou with rebukes<WH08433> dost correct<WH03256><WTH8765> man<WH0376> for iniquity<WH05771>, thou makest his beauty<WH02530><WTH8803> to consume away<WH04529><WTH8686> like a moth<WH06211>: surely every man<WH0120> <FI>is<Fi> vanity<WH01892>. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>his...: Heb. that which is to be desired in him to melt away<Rf>

Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> my prayer<WH08605>, O LORD<WH03068>, and give ear<WH0238><WTH8685> unto my cry<WH07775>; hold not thy peace<WH02790><WTH8799> at my tears<WH01832>: for I <FI>am<Fi> a stranger<WH01616> with thee, <FI>and<Fi> a sojourner<WH08453>, as all my fathers<WH01> <FI>were<Fi> .
O spare<WH08159><WTH8685> me, that I may recover strength<WH01082><WTH8686>, before I go hence<WH03212><WTH8799>, and be no more.<CM>
